title: 换掉头条：不等于改掉规则，那什么才算数？
speaker: Rashad Robinson

segments.en: Well, we live in this age of likes shares followers and so the kind of changing a headline get a mistaken for actually changing a set of rules.
segments.zh: 我们生活在一个点赞、分享、粉丝的时代，所以改变一个标题，常常被误认为真的改变了一套规则。

segments.en: That's the difference between presence and power and I think sometimes we can get really excited by the awareness that people sort of know about the issue.
segments.zh: 这就是“在场”和“权力”的区别。有时候，人们知道某个问题，这种意识会让我们很兴奋。

segments.en: They may care. We may even see polling numbers that say you know the majority of Americans want sensible gun reform but the power to actually get there is not about the polling or the awareness or the headlines.
segments.zh: 他们可能关心。我们甚至看到民调显示大多数美国人想要合理的枪支改革，但真正实现目标的权力，并不在于民调、意识或头条新闻。

segments.en: It is about sort of all the ways in which you build leverage all the ways in which you change incentive structures all the ways in which you build enough energy so that you can force something happen that would not otherwise happen.
segments.zh: 它关乎你如何建立杠杆，如何改变激励结构，如何积聚足够的能量，从而推动那些原本不会发生的事情发生。

segments.en: I felt this point so deeply and I think it's such a good point because as someone who's covered so many protests the thing I always say is okay but how are you going to do that?
segments.zh: 我深有感触，这观点很好。作为报道过许多抗议活动的人，我总说：好吧，但你打算怎么做？

segments.en: What are your actually standing out yelling changing your Instagram to a color is not going to do it but I'm wondering if it can almost even have the opposite effect because people who may disagree with you.
segments.zh: 你真正站出来喊口号，把Instagram头像换成一种颜色，这并不能解决问题。但我想知道，这是否可能产生反效果，因为那些可能不同意你的人……

segments.en: Or people who may agree with you feel like you're overrepresented and maybe it's solved. Look I see it everywhere and then they don't take the action they need to.
segments.zh: 或者那些同意你的人觉得你被过度代表了，也许问题已经解决了。看，我到处都看到这种情况，然后他们就不采取必要的行动了。

segments.en: 100% you know when we stake presence for power you could think something has happened that hasn't actually happened.
segments.zh: 百分之百。当我们把“在场”当作“权力”时，你会以为有些事情已经发生了，但实际上并没有。

segments.en: The black president meaning that your post-racial right so folks think all the work is over.
segments.zh: 比如有了黑人总统，就意味着后种族时代来了，所以人们认为所有工作都结束了。

segments.en: You know the thing about protest as well is that someone that have just become choreography.
segments.zh: 你知道，关于抗议的一点是，它有时已经变成了精心编排的表演。

segments.en: Folks show up to a certain place at a certain time by the end of the day everything's cleaned up the media cycle goes on.
segments.zh: 人们在特定时间出现在特定地点，一天结束，一切清理干净，媒体周期继续。

segments.en: And no one is nervous about disappointing the communities that showed up.
segments.zh: 没有人担心会让那些站出来的人群失望。
